name: The Villain's Maid
source:
A 29 year old girl lives in a world filled with fantasy creatures, heroes, and villains. One day, the most famous villain in the world appears in her town, and she leaves the door open to him. Once meeting him, he asks her to become his maid! Will she take the offer? And if she does, will the big bad's minions welcome her with open arms?

[From [url=https://iamlevil.itch.io/the-villains-maid]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名29岁的女孩生活在一个充满奇幻生物、英雄和恶棍的世界里。有一天，世界上最著名的恶棍出现在她的小镇上，她向他敞开了大门。一见面，他就邀请她做他的侍女！她会接受这个提议吗？如果她这样做了，大坏蛋的爪牙会张开双臂欢迎她吗？

[来自[url=https://iamlevil.itch.io/the-villains-maid]itch.io[/url]]
